name: MailAutomationsPipeline
description: Hourly run of the mail automations (MailAutomationsRunner workflow): RunDueAutomations runs every active automation whose day and hour have arrived and that has not yet run this month. Replaces the daily open-debts batch (OpenDebtsBatch) and the openDebtsDay setting. Drafts land in the outbox (Approvals); nothing is sent.
